title: Grass_cleaner
description: This mod its simple as it gets, help you clean grass in a easy way!
body:
Tired of clearing tall grass and ferns by hand? Grass Cleaner adds a specialized tool designed to help you clean up your landscape in seconds, making it the perfect companion for builders and terraformers.

✨ What does it do?
The mod introduces a custom hoe specifically optimized for vegetation removal. Instead of clicking every single block, this tool allows you to clear large patches of grass quickly and efficiently, saving you time and durability on your main tools.

Fast Clearing: Remove grass and weeds instantly.

Simple & Lightweight: No complex mechanics, just a tool that does exactly what you need.

Builder Friendly: Perfect for preparing a flat area before starting a new project.
